headline: AI Has Completely Rewritten the Rules of the Stock Market
summary: AI on/AI off is now driving the stock market.  Rocky Fishman at Asym Research points out that of the 11 sectors that make up the  five have a zero or negative correlation with the index over the past five months, including healthcare and real estate.  If I told you the  exchange-traded fund is up 1.2% this week—it is—you wouldn’t be any closer to knowing that the S&P 500 is falling 0.2%, which it is.

headline: These 4 Stocks Fit the Ideal LBO Target Profile Right Now
summary: Buyout shops have a precise checklist for pulling a public company off the market, and right now four beaten-down U.S. stocks are checking every single box for a potential take-private deal.

headline: Disney’s Kraft Heinz Partnership Offers a Way Forward for the Stock
summary: Walt Disney  stock has been an absolute dog this year, dropping 17% on concerns about consumer demand and the health of its media businesses.  Kraft Heinz  and Disney announced what they called a strategic alliance that “spans food service, media, events and more,” and will include “storytelling-driven offerings.”  When we begged Disney for more, we were primly informed, “We don’t have any more to share today.”
